cross_scale_descriptive_only.r4_scale_anchor: R4/C5 (descriptive): the blind-attainable share of the gain grows with scale -- crossed TrainShare for A2-gray 0.7785 [0.6418, 0.9214] canonical / 0.8402 [0.7457, 0.9456] strict at 7B against a 3B pooled 0.487 [0.383, 0.588] (reports/c5_r4_readout_v1.json, docs/registered_c5_7b_access_pair_v1.md)
cross_scale_descriptive_only.status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY -- no cross-scale difference, ratio, interval or test is computed anywhere in this report

bootstrap.seed_derivation: pooled lenient seed, pooled strict seed+1; for the k-th template in sorted order lenient seed+100+10k, strict +1; both sides resampled on the same pair indices per replicate
bootstrap.variance_note: intervals quantify evaluation uncertainty on a fixed pair set; they do not estimate run-to-run RL variance -- each arm is one run

instrument.decision_rule: **Decision rule.** **MOVED** iff the 95% paired-bootstrap CI excludes zero in the positive direction. A positive point estimate whose interval contains zero is **NOT MOVED** — not "a trend". **MOVED_NEGATIVE_DIRECTION** iff the CI lies entirely below zero. Identical to the Gate-1 rule (`reports/mini_a5_gate1_endpoint_readout_v1.json` → `instrument`).
instrument.editorial_stance: the instrument reports; it does not editorialize
instrument.not_reused: scripts/build_mini_a5_gate1_endpoint_readout.py -- its ARM_ORDER, ARM_LABELS and ARM_CHECKPOINT_TOKENS are hard-coded to the Mini-A5 arms and its --base-report is the 3B base
instrument.orientation: every contrast is called with left = the 7B base cell and right = the arm cell, so every registered delta is arm minus base

instrument_separation.statement: no estimand and no intermediate structure combines rows from the two instruments; R20 is a replication of R19, never a pool with it

invariants.I10: adversarial fixtures (tests/test_build_c6_mechanism_at_scale_readout_fixture.py) pass on synthetic cells before the instrument touches real cells
invariants.I13: the three task roles are never aggregated into an endpoint; pooled values appear only under keys containing NOT_AN_ENDPOINT; no shard-level quantity appears at all
invariants.I7: lenient and contract-strict reported for every cell, role and contrast; never merged or averaged; a disagreement is the result
invariants.seed_scope: every emitted number carries seed_tag 'one seed (data.seed 1; single 7B training pair)'; no between-seed variance claim is made anywhere in C6

question: does the readout/anchor dissociation established at 3B still hold when the trained model is 7B? Nothing else is at issue
